name: Leadfeeder
summary: Website visitor identification for B2B sales. See which companies visit your site and what they viewed, and turn anonymous traffic into a warm pipeline.
best_for: B2B teams with real website traffic and a sales team that will actually work the list — the free tier is enough to find out whether your traffic contains anyone worth calling
skip_if: your traffic is mostly consumer or very low volume, because company identification needs business networks to match against and thin traffic produces a thin list
honest_knock: The words doing the work are 'starting at'. What actually sets your price is how many companies you identify a month, and the tier table sits behind a 'How is the price calculated?' link rather than on the plan cards, which still read 'Tiered'. Opened, it shows that €79 buys up to 50 identified companies a month on Discover; 51-100 is €109, 101-200 €139, 201-400 €179, 401-500 €249 and 501-1,000 €309, all billed annually (pricing page, read 12 October 2026). Month to month costs 43% more on the same tier (€113 against €79, €441 against €309), and Scale is annual-only, so the tier most growing teams land on cannot be tried for a month.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-08-26 on leadfeeder.com/pricing over a US connection) Lite is free forever with a 14-day full trial, seven days of visitor history and the last 100 companies a month. Discover starts at $79 a month, Activate at $369 and Scale at $599, all billed annually, which the page marks as 30% off. Worth knowing: the page carries both currencies with the same figures — $79 for an American is €79 for a European, not a converted amount — so the euro price is the more expensive of the two. Re-verified 12 October 2026 from a Netherlands exit: Lite €0, Discover from €79, Activate from €369 and Scale from €599 a month billed annually, the toggle still marked SAVE 30%. The page now publishes the full tier table behind its 'How is the price calculated?' link: Discover €79 / €109 / €139 / €179 / €249 / €309 for up to 50, 51-100, 101-200, 201-400, 401-500 and 501-1,000 identified companies a month (month to month €113 / €156 / €199 / €256 / €356 / €441); Activate from €369 (1,000 companies, 200 credits; €527 month to month) to €729 (4,000 companies, 1,500 credits; €1,041); Scale, billed annually only, from €599 (2,000 companies, 1,000 credits) to €2,089 (10,000 companies, 5,500 credits). Extra credits come in non-renewing blocks of 100 to 5,000, valid for two years; plan credits do not roll over at the end of the contract period.
